__doc__: Integration hand-off fragment for sim-route-alerts-v2. MERGE the route_alerts block into a mission runtime-config (e.g. mission-runtime-cc.json) to turn the robot into a mobile store sensor on the drive. Default-off when absent (byte-identical). Two delivered modes via route_alerts.mode (or the launcher --route-alerts / --route-alerts=act): 'findings' (the WORKING DEFAULT) is sensor-only -- it publishes robot.route_alert.* events + staff tasks + the evidence log next to mission.json, but navigation is byte-identical (latest_detections() returns []). 'act' (the SMART variant) additionally feeds a confirmed OBSTRUCTION footprint into the EXISTING dynobs costmap layer to raise the route cost -- so 'act' REQUIRES the navigation block below (nav_mode sensor + navigation.dynamic_obstacles, the layer sim-restock-dynobs-v1 owns); isaac_bundle wires route_alerts.latest_detections() as the single detection_source and refuses to share it with navigation.dynamic_obstacle_source (composing the humans feed + route-alerts feed is a follow-up). GDPR: live people-masking needs config.agents_factory wired to the humans lane's detections, else the hook refuses to analyse (no un-masked detector over people). The spill/obstruction classical paths are CPU; set a detector's gpu:true only for its open-vocab refine (shares the mission GPU). No GPU run was done from this lane -- see data/sim-route-alerts-v2/report.md for the CPU evidence this fragment reproduces live.

route_alerts.__floors_note__: PLACEHOLDER identity homography. The camera lane (sim-restock-camera-v2) supplies the real route-camera image->floor homography from the mount extrinsics + floor plane (see scripts/run_route_alerts_smoke.py:image_to_floor_homography and twin.route_alerts.recorded.floor_calibration).

__act_mode_note__: For --route-alerts=act (route_alerts.mode='act'), ALSO merge this navigation block so the obstruction feed has the dynobs layer to raise cost through. nav_mode must be 'sensor'. Do NOT also set navigation.dynamic_obstacle_source in act mode -- the single detection_source is taken by route-alerts.
